categories.label: Victory points on track
categories.hint: Include the +5 VP for the player who triggered game end and +100/+200 lap marker.

categories.label: Leftover coins converted to VP
categories.labelVi: Xu còn lại quy đổi VP
categories.hint: ratio = coins per 1 VP: 5 default, 3 if you claimed the 36+ coin space, 2 if the 50+ coin space.

categories.label: Decorations on constructed buildings (sets)
categories.hint: Enter how many of each decoration type you placed; a set of n same decorations scores n(n+1) (1:2, 2:6, 3:12, 4:20, 5:30, 6:42, 7:56).

notes: family: set-collection + area-majority. Advanced version with decorations, statues and Royal Court. Statue colour is ignored for majority; city column order from score board read from rulebook image (Livorno 12/6/3, Pisa 11/5/2, Lucca 10/5/2, Viareggio 9/4/2, Massa 8/4/2, Lerici 7/3/1). Decoration type names not captured (6 types, a1-a6). Gold statues from the Royal Court appear on the score board with a '>' symbol; their effect was not verified and is not modelled.
